header.scoreTable: Exact +(call² + 10), an exact 0 is +25, missing costs -(10 × the difference). All four exact or all four missing doubles either way.

hint.israeliwhistAuctionBid: This hand is worth winning the auction with.
hint.israeliwhistAuctionPass: Not worth winning the auction — drop out.
hint.israeliwhistBid: Counted from the high cards in your hand.
hint.israeliwhistMeetQuota: You won the auction, so you must call at least your quota.
hint.israeliwhistAvoidRestricted: Your estimate is the barred number, so this shifts by one.
hint.israeliwhistWinTrick: You are short of your call — go for this trick.
hint.israeliwhistDuck: You already have your call — avoid taking more.

tutorial.score: You score **only for an exact call**, and it rises with the **square** of the call (an exact 7 is 59). Missing costs in proportion to the difference. **All four exact, or all four wrong, doubles the round.**
tutorial.twoStage: Bidding happens **twice**. First an auction for "n tricks + a trump suit" (minimum 5; suits rank ♣ < ♦ < ♥ < ♠), then **everyone, the winner included, calls their own target**. The winner must call at least their quota, and whoever calls last may not make the total 13.
tutorial.seats: Each seat's **auction standing** (won / passed / bidding) and **its own call**, tricks taken and running total. The two bidding rounds are separate, so both stay on screen.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Legal cards get a green ring. Once you have your call, the play is to duck everything else.
